rows.sourceTitle: 萬松老人評唱天童覺和尚拈古請益錄

Override.AttributionNote: Wansong Xingxiu's Evaluations of Hongzhi Zhengjue's Old Cases (萬松老人評唱天童覺和尚拈古請益錄). Wansong Xingxiu is the exact speaker, marked 師云 at the start of this continuous evaluation; he enumerates old-case raising, verse, probing, substitution, and alternative responses. Shakyamuni Buddha, Yangshan Huiji, and Fayan Wenyi are quoted or discussed within Wansong's evaluation, while Hongzhi Zhengjue is the old-case author being commented upon. The Fayan header is not the speaker of this genre list.
